items.item_text: Experience working with the terms & conditions surrounding Federal and University-based student loan programs.

Experience in reading and interpreting regulations, the underlying codification, the determination of Federal, State, and Local laws and how they interact with loan program regulations and promissory notes.
Experience in accounts receivable in addition to experience using various programs and software for word processing, spreadsheets, and database management programs.

Under general supervision of the Student Accounting Supervisor, this position assumes responsibility for all aspects of the campus loan counseling program, including conducting exit loan counseling to UC Davis students, overseeing the loan records management, and performing loan program documentation administration. This position is also responsible for the collection on accounts receivable from former and current students and the non-student receivables processed through Banner. The incumbent is also responsible to administrate the returned electronic payments.

Working knowledge of consumer collection industry "best practices" and regulations including, the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act, the Fair Credit Reporting Act, Federal privacy and Bankruptcy Regulations, and applicable state laws, as well as pertinent UC and campus policies and procedures.
Knowledge of university accounting procedures and campus systems (BANNER, Oracle, Cognos).
Math skills sufficient to calculate interest and percentages and to project quarterly and monthly payments of varying amounts and interest rates.
Knowledge of University policies and procedures.

Interpersonal communication and customer services skills to clearly and effectively interact with individuals of varying ages, cultural backgrounds, perspectives to secure and/or provide information to clarify situations, resolve problems, make referrals, and interact with the general public in a helpful and positive manner.

Strong interpersonal skills including tact, diplomacy, and flexibility to facilitate communication and interactions with a variety of personalities in a high volume and sometimes negative contact setting regarding loans.
Organizational and time management skills to independently establish priorities and coordinate and complete competing assignments within established time-frames.
